Definition: an Avvite or native of Avvah (only plural)
BiblicalUsage: The Avvites were a people of Avvah, brought by the king of Assyria to settle the cities of Samaria. They made Nibhaz and Tartak, their own gods, and Joshua lists their land among the coasts still to be taken.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a people is known by the gods it brings with it, and the Avvites are my warning that new neighbours can mean new idols.
